name: Sophia
summary: A media-facing social android from David Hanson's Hanson Robotics, with patented 'Frubber' skin, dozens of facial expressions and scripted plus chatbot-driven dialogue. Sophia does not walk (a legged version was shown once, using DRC-HUBO legs). Its 2017 'Saudi citizenship' stunt and heavy talk-show presence made it the most famous — and most debated — humanoid of the 2010s.
notable: Most publicly visible social robot of the 2010s
Focal point of debate over robot hype and 'robot rights'
